name: Under the Flyover
brief: While travelling in Hyderabad at night, I saw a homeless child squatting beneath a flyover, wearing dirty, torn clothes and deeply absorbed in scrolling reels on a smartphone. The contrast disturbed me. I want to explore that moment through a short, realistic film. The location is beneath a flyover at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed containing soil, with a few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils, not a tent. Use a fictional child. Distinguish the observed moment from creative additions; do not invent a backstory or assert that scrolling caused his poverty. The location reference @underpass is a user-supplied AI-generated image, not a photograph of the actual incident; use its night lighting as the visual reference.

direction.palette: night: warm sodium streetlight glancing off concrete pillars and asphalt, deep shadow under the flyover, cool blue-black sky
direction.notes: no music; no on-screen text or logos

decisions: The child is fictional and must not resemble any identifiable real child.
Keep the observed moment separate from creative additions; no invented backstory.
Do not suggest that scrolling, or the phone, caused his poverty.
Location: beneath a flyover at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed of soil with a few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils; not a tent.
Night. The supplied @underpass image (AI-generated, not a photo of the incident) is the lighting reference.
The first video uses only @boy and @underpass; the smartphone is described in the action (a separate phone asset is deferred).
